fields.value: MoVi: A Large Multipurpose Motion and Video Dataset

dsDescriptionValue.value: MoVi is the first human motion dataset to contain synchronized pose, pose-dependent shape and video recordings. The MoVi database can be applied in human pose estimation and tracking, human motion prediction and synthesis, action recognition and gait analysis.
